voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`). captionY (px or "high") lifts the caption above low action.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, Astika sub-parva, adhyaya 29 (second part): flying out with the soma, Garuda meets Vishnu in the sky; Vishnu, pleased that he had not drunk it though he held it, offers him a boon; Garuda asks to stand above him, and to be free of age and death without the amrita; Vishnu grants both; Garuda offers Vishnu a boon in return, and Vishnu chooses him as his mount, and makes him his banner, so that Garuda sits above him. (The cliffhanger looks ahead: Indra strikes him with the vajra.)
structure: From episode 21 (independent review): COLD OPEN (≤ 8 words, ≤ 3 s; opening style B: direct speech in medias res, the line itself on the card) → title (hook post) → STORY from ≈ 5 s with the UNVOICED recap band over its first shot (KIT.series.recapBand) → turn at 40–60 % → the cliffhanger image + line → a ≤ 1.2 s NEXT › band over the cliffhanger image that dissolves into frame 1 (KIT.series.overlayNextScene). No fire edge in the Garuda arc from here.

strings.recapLine: Garuda took the amrita, and did not drink it.

lines.speaker: garuda
lines.note: COLD OPEN (style B, in medias res, moving from frame 1): Garuda, the white pot in his talons, faces Vishnu in a gold dawn sky; the camera rises past Vishnu's crown to Garuda's eye; the line on the card.

lines.text: Flying out with the amrita, Garuda met Vishnu in the sky.
lines.say: Flying out with the amrita, [p:100] Garuda met Vishnu in the sky.
lines.note: STORY 1 with the unvoiced recap band: NEW LIGHT, the sky at first light over a cloud-sea, gold below and blue above: Vishnu standing in the air in his deep-blue light; Garuda coming in with the pot; plaque.

lines.speaker: vishnu
lines.text: "You held the amrita, and did not drink it. I am pleased. Choose a boon."
lines.say: You held the amrita, [p:80] and did not drink it. [p:200] I am pleased. [p:150] Choose a boon.
lines.note: STORY 2 (Vishnu speaks): Vishnu frontal, LARGE, his hand opening in blessing.

lines.speaker: garuda
lines.note: STORY 3: after a short rest, Garuda's bold request, close on his eagle head, then a cut wide: the bird above the god.

lines.speaker: garuda
lines.text: "And let me be free of age and death, without the amrita."
lines.say: And let me be free of age and death, [p:120] without the amrita.
lines.note: STORY 4 (Garuda speaks): Garuda holds the pot out, away from himself.

lines.speaker: vishnu
lines.note: STORY 5 (Vishnu speaks): Vishnu's hand in abhaya; a ring of blue light passes over Garuda.

lines.text: From then on, he needed no amrita. Age and death could not touch him.
lines.say: From then on, [p:80] he needed no amrita. [p:200] Age and death could not touch him.
lines.note: STORY 5b: Garuda alone in the gold light, wings opening wide, the pot held out from him; a calm glow settles on him.

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: Then the bird offered a boon to the god.
lines.say: Then the bird [p:80] offered a boon to the god.
lines.note: FRAME (Sauti at the Naimisha fire, a seventeenth angle: wide and level, all the sages turned to Sauti, his palm held up as if offering).

lines.speaker: garuda
lines.text: "I too will give you a boon. Ask, Lord."
lines.say: I too will give you a boon. [p:200] Ask, Lord.
lines.note: STORY 6 · THE TURN (≈ 58 %): after a 0.9 s rest, the reversal: the bird offers the god a boon (direct speech); Garuda bows his head, wings half-folded.

lines.speaker: vishnu
lines.note: STORY 7 (Vishnu speaks): close two-shot, Vishnu's hand comes to rest on Garuda's shoulder.

lines.text: And Vishnu set him on his banner, so the bird sits above the god.
lines.say: And Vishnu set him on his banner, [p:100] so the bird sits above the god.
lines.note: STORY 8: NEW LIGHT, a white-gold sky: Vishnu's tall banner-staff, and at its top Garuda's image on the banner, above the god; plaque.

lines.text: So each had his wish: the bird above the god, the god upon the bird.
lines.say: So each had his wish: [p:120] the bird above the god, [p:100] the god upon the bird.
lines.note: STORY 9: Vishnu seated on Garuda's back in flight, and above them the banner with Garuda's image (both at once).
NEXT 1 (cliffhanger, the catalog line): Indra on a storm-cloud behind them, the vajra blazing as it leaves his hand.
